protocol.aggregation: Batch3 total complete elapsed / total shots; per-shot Min3 and Median3 then mean
protocol.timed_scope: Normal API, result store and cleanup; batch final drain inside last block; latency drain separately recorded
protocol.team_scope: One resident team over warmup and measurement; entry/exit excluded
protocol.ordering: cyclic method rotation within each case/mode/repeat; all paired methods share one node
protocol.placement: Static historical-work LPT over six nodes; repeats may use different nodes, recorded explicitly
protocol.correctness: Exact original shot ID, event count, integer weight and observable; no relaxation after collection

distributions.ccdf: strict P(L>t) at every distinct threshold

protocol.stopping: Complete all 882 calls; retain all rounds and failures; no speed-based early stopping
